subject: Film & Cinema
title: Jordan Peele: Horror as Social Mirror
description: A 60-second lesson on Jordan Peele: Horror as Social Mirror.

hook.text: A comedian made one of the most acclaimed horror films ever. Nobody saw it coming.

buildup.text: Get Out used horror conventions to dissect liberal racism with surgical precision.

discovery.text: Peele proved horror is the perfect genre for social commentary — fear opens the mind.

twist.text: Us and Nope showed he wasn't a one-hit wonder — he's building a unique cinematic universe.

climax.text: Peele made studios realize horror audiences want intelligence, not just gore.

punchline.text: The funniest man in the room became the scariest.

quiz.question: What was Jordan Peele's career before directing?
